title: IG Metall metal workers stage warning strikes in Bavaria

tea.why: Metal and electrical industry workers are staging warning strikes following failed collective bargaining negotiations.
tea.want: The union demands a 5 percent wage increase.
tea.changed: Nov 20: Production halted at the Audi plant in Ingolstadt as part of 24-hour warning strikes across Bavaria.

summary: Metal workers at the Audi plant in Ingolstadt and other industrial sites in Bavaria staged 24-hour warning strikes. The industrial action was organized by the IG Metall union following failed collective bargaining negotiations. While the union demanded a 5 percent wage increase, the employers' side offered a 1.3 percent raise. Previous actions in the ongoing wage dispute included a major rally on the Audi-Piazza in Ingolstadt, which drew thousands of participants according to different estimates. The union escalated the dispute by initiating 24-hour warning strikes across various facilities in the region.
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: The strike wave reached a high point with about 36,000 workers participating in temporary work stoppages across 110 businesses.
Following failed tariff negotiations, IG Metall Bavaria decided to escalate the dispute to 24-hour warning strikes.
Production at the Audi plant in Ingolstadt halted for a full-day warning strike.
